notes.title: December 2024 patch
notes.content:
Apologies for the update size, it includes a lot of small changes and fixes of lots of different scenarios and units.

- Fallschirmjäger voices fix
- US off map mortar observer bug fix
- US armour crew fixes
- US sniper smoke grenade bug fix
- “Green Devils” scenario difficulty adjustments
- “Bastion” scenario performance threshold adjustments
- “Textbook” scenario save/load bug fix
- Optimisation of unit roster for future changes
- Various small scenario and bug fixes

notes.content:
- US Forces DLC now available!
- New units for base game Skirmish and Battlegroup modes: Sdkfz 234 "Stummel", Commonwealth infantry flamethrower teams.
- AT charge bocage breach mechanic.
- AI improvements.
- Various small improvements and bug fixes.
